cues.text: My name’s Lucy Crittenden, and I’m the Director of Operations for an organisation that
arranges volunteering in this part of the country.
I’m hoping I can persuade one or two of you to become volunteers yourselves.
Volunteers can do all sorts of things, depending on their own abilities and interests.
If they’re supporting a family that’s struggling, they might do some painting or
wallpapering, or even some babysitting so that parents can go out for a while.
Volunteering may be a valuable element of their CV when they’re applying for jobs.
Significantly, most volunteers feel that what they’re doing gives them a purpose in their
Habib supports an elderly lady with dementia.
Songs at the community centre take the listeners back to their youth for a while.
Consuela has difficulty walking herself, but she encourages people with similar
difficulties to walk more and more.
Minh helps a young man who lives alone to go out to the cinema or visit friends.
Tanya inspired an elderly woman to try making soft toys for herself.
Alexei helps a family realise they can do something themselves to improve their situation.
Juba works with a teenage girl with learning difficulties, and now the girl is far better
at expressing herself and understanding other people.
